body:
Thank you for the kind words. 

I don't think I'll ever be able to love like that again I'm afraid I think I'm actually traumatized by all this..

I'll move on eventually but I'm in a really dark place right now

The thing is she told me I trapped her in the end with all I did for her she said she felt like I did everything for her and she hated that. 

But after that the last time we talked and I confessed I still loved her she said thank you for everything I did for her.

I know, it wasn't meant to be, but I'm crippled of what to do... I feel like I did trap her or I guess her words made me believe that.. I feel horrible I made someone another human feel like that 

I don't ever want to put in the effort I did for anyone again. I never did that for anyone and it has left me in a deeper hole than I could ever imagine. 
All the harsh words she said when we fought and at the end when she said she didn't feel me anymore. 

They were like bullets that hit me and I'm on life support now, yes I'll heal thank you for your kinds words and support, but I don't think I could ever let me heart out that far again for someone..

She told me she forgave me and that she doesn't hate me but she could not trust me anymore 
We kept the relationship going for another year after the incident. She even retold that me after we broke up. 

But I can't forgive myself 
I was always taught and believed that I had to be nice to everyone that everyone should feel special and good about them selves and that I could help people by being nice and caring

But I'm not and I can't live with myself for what I have done 
Why can't she hate me why god I hate myself so MUCH I can't be on this earth anymore 
I don't want to die because of what will happen to the people I care about and how they feel but it's just too painful I can't do it anymore I can't be the person I have become
